scope: Confirmed reconstructed championship winners from 2023-2025; franchise continuity rather than team display names controls trophy display.

rules.marker: One trophy for a verified title-winning franchise, displaying years and a title count when needed.
rules.historical_aliases: Resolve an historical team by (season, ESPN ID), never by display name.
rules.unknown_titles: No trophy for unverified claimed titles; Quattro Padres has no confirmed title in these records.
rules.owner_privacy: Store no owner or manager identifiers.
